bullets.text: Ukraine has accused Russia of committing a war crime after a video emerged showing a civilian being pursued by a Russian drone in what Ukraine described as a 'human safari' attack.
The EU has praised Spain's rapid handling of the Ceuta migrant crisis, with approximately 70,000 of the 72,000 individuals who illegally entered Ceuta last week having been returned to Morocco.
Anti-LGBTQ+ laws are reportedly increasing across West Africa, with campaigners warning that politicians are using LGBTQ+ individuals as scapegoats to maintain power.
An investigation by regulators has found the founder and two other senior staff members of an alternative Melbourne school unfit for positions of authority within the Victorian education system.

Federal police are investigating the vandalism of a Melbourne defence manufacturer and the torching of nearby cars as a potential terrorist act by 'far-left extremists', with perpetrators facing possible life imprisonment.
The Home Affairs minister has quietly de-prioritised overseas skilled workers to reduce net overseas migration, a move the Coalition criticises as 'managing migration by stealth'.
SpaceX reported a 92% rise in revenue in its debut earnings report, outperforming analyst expectations for the second quarter, although shares dropped as much as 8%.
US stocks jumped, with the S&P 500 hitting a record high, after reports of an imminent deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and strong corporate earnings.
Toyota plans a $6.3 billion buyback, with a weak yen boosting its outlook and the company expecting to sell over 5 million hybrid electric vehicles this year.
